info.title: Business Platform API
info.description: Identity, category administration, category-derived Catalog, B5 Media and Admin product management. Minimal inactive Product creation requires a live leaf category and Arabic name; Category and reusable group relationships are authoritative; legacy classification is absent from runtime contracts. Category schema revisions protect edits; publication separately requires complete values and a ready image cover. Live staff verification, optimistic versions, exact typed values, ordered Media and retained soft deletion remain. Production provider/isolation acceptance and deployment are separate. Public collections/search/category-derived filters are integrated; normal frontend defaults to real APIs.

post.description: ADMIN atomic branch move. Checks source row and both affected sibling scopes, including roots. Preserves descendant IDs and all ownership/technical links. Source/destination parent versions advance; event and mutations commit together. Discard affected pagination cursors. Gap-based ordering or bounded normalization (500 siblings); exhausted larger sets return 422 without changes.

get.description: Only active products in live categories with a ready, unblocked image cover and live type. Exact decimals, false booleans and choice IDs remain intact. Complete reorder bounded at 500. Attribute ranking is applied within group placement; group order controls grouped display and ungrouped fields follow groups.
